methodology: Current captures originate from the upstream pseudonymized WEBP set. Local Windows OCR at 2x scale plus manual review identifies full, fragmented and truncated GUID-shaped strings for solid pixel overwrites. Profile areas and identified legacy personal details are also masked. Images are decoded and re-encoded without source metadata. GUID masking does not certify the absence of all other personal or confidential information. Five ServiceNow pages have no upstream capture, so they were rendered locally from the upstream application at the pinned commit using fictional mock API responses and a synthetic session; they contain no tenant data and no masks were applied.
